facts.claim: Costa Smeralda (Costa Cruises): Entered service 2019; 185,010 GT; 5220 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 337 m length; Excellence class.

The Costa Smeralda is a coastal area and tourist destination in northern Sardinia, Italy, with a length of some 20 km, although the term originally designated only a small stretch in the commune of Arzachena.

catalogSpecs.description: Excellence-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2019; 185,010 GT; approx. 5,220 guests.
